recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-13265 unless a future work-group decision changes the spelling or semantics of Identifier.use=old.
issue_request: FHIR-13265 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core datatypes request from MnM to add an Identifier.use code for formerly valid identifier values that should no longer be used, with the approved code old and definition about identifiers no longer considered valid but still relevant for search purposes.
initial_application: The request was applied in imported SVN/git history: b23a8cfeb3df4a5bb14f330a1d66d1ba5d8252b5 added the identifier-use table row for old, and edad93b2907ce672e950928916a5119aae5095d3 added old to the Identifier.use allowed-code list. This matches the Jira comment citing SVN revisions 12456-12457.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Identifier as an active datatype and routes datatypes to the datatypes publication page, while source/bindings.ini still lists IdentifierUse. A Jira neighborhood search found only FHIR-13265 for the Identifier.use old/deprecated identifier terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion or Jira references.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/datatypes/identifier.xml already lists old in Identifier.use and defines the identifier-use code old with the requested no-longer-valid/search-purpose wording.
